name: Gulf / US–Iran war
value: Tankers hit by mines off Khasab 26 Nov
summary: Iran's Guards say two tankers hit mines off Khasab on 26 Nov; Saudi Jazan refinery struck the same day
state: Iran's Revolutionary Guards said on 26 Nov that two oil tankers hit sea mines north of Oman's Khasab while using an unauthorised route through Hormuz (Deccan Herald, Reuters wire). UKMTO reported a projectile blast near a tanker 50 nautical miles west of Dubai the same day (Times of Israel), and a projectile hit Saudi Arabia's Jazan refinery, killing a worker (Al Jazeera). Attacks on shipping and Gulf energy infrastructure keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice for Iran and the Gulf states, which may change at short notice. Mariners should follow UKMTO advisories.
rubric_hit: Attacks on Gulf shipping and energy infrastructure; Hormuz impeded

sources.title: Deccan Herald (Reuters) — Iran's Revolutionary Guards say two oil tankers hit sea mines near Oman's Khasab

why: Direct hostilities between Iran and the US or Israel threaten Gulf energy infrastructure, the Strait of Hormuz and the wider region.
drivers: Strikes and retaliation, attacks on shipping and Gulf states, mediation and ceasefire talks, US force posture.

rubric.alert: Active strikes between states, attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure or shipping, or the Strait of Hormuz substantially closed.
rubric.watch: A ceasefire or stalemate with sporadic strikes, or credible threats of renewed strikes.
rubric.normal: No direct state-on-state hostilities; diplomacy active.
